body: Ticket detail: 'Plan & readiness' section with readiness reasons (provider waits, blockers), resolved code plan (implements/consumes/changes, requires/provides, contract input → output, provider tickets) and the design-check diagnostics for that ticket. New Design view: check summary, all diagnostics, component tree with contracts and the tickets implementing/consuming/changing them, shared types. Endpoints GET /api/tickets/:id/plan and GET /api/design. IDs in messages are shown as ticket titles. Verified in Chromium with the UserService/Cart example.
author: claude
